name: email-field
title: Email field
description: An email input that catches typos before they cost a signup: it offers the likely domain, such as gmail.com for gmial.com, and reports a clean address.
docs: Controlled with value and onValueChange(email, { valid }), or uncontrolled with defaultValue. The reported address is trimmed with its domain in lower case, and name sends that clean form in a hidden input. Nothing shows while typing: on leaving the field a malformed address is explained in words, or, when the domain is one or two edits from a provider in domains, a button offers 'Use rick@gmail.com instead'. Set suggest={false} to turn the suggestion off. The domain list, editDistance, suggestEmail, describeEmail and isValidEmail are exported from email-field/emails for your own checks. Set noValidate on the form if you prefer these messages to the browser's own.
